title: 第11章 纯阳剑体第12章 纯阳剑体觉醒
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 铁剑门掌门在回去之后，亦让长老准备一些厚礼送去清风宗。铁剑宗传承悠久，宗中有对付先天的宝物，但是同样他也不会无缘无故的去得罪一个先天境高手。
虎拳门，议事厅中，虎天雄与几位长老脸色阴沉，这突然的变故打得他们有些措手不及。
本来唾手可得的清风宗，现在竹篮打水一场空。
现在又让虎拳门颜面尽损，这让他们对于秦叶与清风宗恨之入骨。
然而，如今秦叶成为了先天强者，这又让他们恐惧不已。
要知道之前那些事情一旦被秦叶得知，一定会上门来讨要说法。
“诸位，这秦叶小儿活着一天，我们就一天不得安生，所以这秦叶必须死。”虎天雄目光扫视着诸位长老，沉声说道。
虎天雄心中也在暗暗后悔，当初就应该斩草除根，竟然留下了秦叶这个祸患。
“掌门，这秦叶如今已是先天强者，即使我们像上次一样围攻偷袭，怕是也杀不了他。”大长老迟疑了一下，还是说道。
“大长老说得极是，先天强者虽与练体只是一境之隔，但是却是天差地别，我们就算一起出手，都不一定是他的对手。”二长老出声附和道。
“无妨，我们不出手，我们请别人出手。”虎天雄冷笑道。
“掌门，这可是先天强者，清风城谁能对付得了他？”大长老问道。
“哈哈……当然不是清风城的，你们可知道血杀。”虎天雄哈哈大笑道。
其他长老一脸迷茫并没有听说过这个血杀，倒是大长老与二长老脸色一变，大长老哆嗦道：“宗主，可是那号称宗师之下皆可杀的杀手组织？”
“不错。”虎天雄点头道。
“传闻这血杀组织恐怖无比，来无影去无踪，曾经因为成功击杀一位先天九重强者而名声大振。”二长老脸色微变，道：“掌门，这请血杀恐怕是要花不少代价。”
“哼！这点代价算什么，这秦叶活着一天，我们就时刻面临着危险。与活着相比，一些身外之物算什么，而且这秦叶身上肯定有什么宝物，等他死了，我们就立刻占领清风宗驻地。”虎天雄目光中充满了野心，他秦叶能突破先天，只要他得到了秦叶身上的宝物，相信自己也能突破先天。
众长老对视一眼，便同时点头道：“我们都支持掌门。”
的确与活着相比，钱财又算得什么，一旦让秦叶查出当初是他们埋伏清风宗，秦叶肯定会报复。一个先天强者的报复，他们根本拦不住，所以他们不能等死。
次日，天空晴朗无比，万里无云，阳光照得大地一片金黄。
清风宗内，大殿之中，秦叶坐在掌门座位上，武萱儿、归海一刀，万尘三人站在殿中。
归海一刀依然是神情冷漠，武萱儿则是一会看看秦叶，一会又看看归海一刀，她虽然入宗才两年，但是师傅对她甚是宠爱，基本上没什么事情瞒她，清风宗若是有这样的前辈，不可能没落到如今的地步。
所以，她根本不相信秦叶所说的。
她虽然不知道归海一刀的具体境界，但是从其身上气势来看，明显不弱于先天。除了叶天，清风城即使有先天境高手，也不会这么轻易被招揽，所以她才好奇这人是从哪里来的。
而万尘这个时候却是激动不已，今天是他拜师的日子，现在清风宗就他一个人，很明显他将是宗主的大弟子，那以后就是大师兄。
“徒儿，拜见师父。”万尘拜师行礼，接着又拜见了归海一刀与武萱儿。
content_en:
After the head of the Iron Sword Sect returned, he also asked the elders to prepare some generous gifts to send to the Qingfeng Sect. The Iron Sword Sect has a long heritage, and the sect has treasures to deal with innates, but he will not offend an innate master for no reason.
…
In the Hu Fist Gate, in the meeting hall, Hu Tianxiong and several elders had gloomy expressions. This sudden turn of events caught them off guard.
The Qingfeng Sect, which was once within easy reach, is now in vain.
Now the Hu Fist Sect has been disgraced, which makes them hate Qin Ye and the Qingfeng Sect deeply.
However, now that Qin Ye has become an innate powerhouse, this makes them terrified.
You must know that once Qin Ye learns about those things before, he will definitely come to ask for an explanation.
"Everyone, as long as this little Qin Ye lives, we will not be able to live in peace for a day, so Qin Ye must die." Hu Tianxiong glanced at the elders and said in a deep voice.
Hu Tianxiong also secretly regretted in his heart that he should have eradicated the problem in the first place, but Qin Ye was left behind as a scourge.
"Master, this Qin Ye is now an innate strong man. Even if we attack him secretly like last time, we probably won't be able to kill him." The elder hesitated for a moment and then said.
"What the Great Elder said is absolutely true. Although the innate powerhouse and the physical training are only separated by one realm, they are worlds apart. Even if we attack together, we may not be his opponents." The second elder echoed.
"It doesn't matter, we don't take action, we ask others to take action." Hu Tianxiong sneered.
"Master, this is an innately strong man, who in Qingfeng City can deal with him?" the great elder asked.
"Haha... Of course I'm not from Qingfeng City. Do you know how to kill with blood?" Hu Tianxiong laughed.
The other elders looked confused and had not heard of this bloody killing. However, the expressions of the first elder and the second elder changed. The first elder trembled and said: "Sect master, is this a killer organization that claims to be able to kill everyone under the master?"
"Not bad." Hu Tianxiong nodded.
"It is rumored that this blood-killing organization is extremely terrifying. It comes and goes without a trace. It once became famous for successfully killing a ninth-level innate powerhouse." The second elder's face changed slightly and said: "Master, this blood-killing will probably cost a lot."
"Huh! This price is nothing. If Qin Ye lives for a day, we will be in danger all the time. Compared with living, some possessions are nothing, and there must be some treasures on Qin Ye. When he dies, we will immediately occupy the Qingfeng Sect." Hu Tianxiong's eyes were full of ambition. He, Qin Ye, can break through the innate. As long as he gets the treasures on Qin Ye's body, he believes that he can also break through the innate.
The elders looked at each other and nodded at the same time: "We all support the leader."
Indeed, compared with life, money is nothing. Once Qin Ye finds out that they ambushed the Qingfeng Sect, Qin Ye will definitely take revenge. They couldn't stop the revenge of an innately strong man, so they couldn't wait to die.
…
The next day, the sky was clear and cloudless, and the sun shone golden on the earth.
In the Qingfeng Sect, in the main hall, Qin Ye was sitting on the leader's seat, Wu Xuan'er, Gui Hai and Wan Chen were standing in the hall.
Guihai Yidao still had an indifferent expression, while Wu Xuaner looked at Qin Ye for a while and then at Guihai Yida. Although she had only been in the sect for two years, her master loved her very much and basically hid nothing from her. If the Qingfeng Sect had such a senior, it would be impossible for him to fall to the current situation.
Therefore, she didn't believe what Qin Ye said at all.
Although she didn't know the specific realm of Guihai Yida, judging from his aura, it was obviously not weaker than Xiantian. Except for Ye Tian, ​​even if there were Xiantian realm masters in Qingfeng City, they would not be recruited so easily, so she was curious about where this person came from.
But Wan Chen was very excited at this time. Today was the day for him to become a disciple. Now he was the only one in the Qingfeng Sect. It was obvious that he would be the eldest disciple of the sect master, and from then on he would be the senior brother.
"Disciple, pay homage to the master." Wan Chen paid homage to his master, and then paid homage to Gui Hai Yida and Wu Xuan'er.
